In square units rounded to one decimal place, find the area of $△ABC$ shown above.
worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC.
$$

We are given that $m∠A={63}^{∘}.$ Notice that relative to $∠A,$ we have expressions for the lengths of the opposite side $\overset{―}{BC}$ and adjacent side $\overset{―}{AC}.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A) & =\frac{BC}{AC} \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡({63}^{∘}) & =\frac{3x+2}{3x} \\ 3x\cdot \operatorname{tan}⁡({63}^{∘}) & =3x+2 \\ 3x\cdot \operatorname{tan}⁡({63}^{∘})-3x & =2 \\ 3x(\operatorname{tan}⁡({63}^{∘})-1) & =2 \\ x & =\frac{2}{3(\operatorname{tan}⁡({63}^{∘})-1)} \\ x & =0.692\,5…\end{aligned}
$$

So, the side lengths are 

$$
\begin{aligned}BC & =3x+2=3(0.692\,5…)+2=4.077\,6…, \\ AC & =3x=3(0.692\,5…)=2.077\,6….\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}(2.077\,6…)(4.077\,6…) \\  & =4.236\,0… \\  & ≈4.2,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the one decimal place.
